phrases.latin: Quōmodo ex olīvīs oleum fit? — Premuntur; oleum quod exit, eō coquō.
phrases.english: How is oil made from olives? — They are pressed; the oil that comes out is what I cook with.
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: Lewis & Short: oleum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 72.
